method: Manual semantic audit of all 95 unique test symptom cores, plus all disagreements from two independently prompted Qwen3-VL runs. No test reference labels available.
development_metrics_caveat: Refined rule accuracy/F1 1.0 were measured after development on training errors, not an independent held-out estimate. Initial grouped CV macro F1 was 0.9777654. Pure E5 retrieval grouped accuracy was about 0.7333.
labels_in_prior_audit_summaries: The fault_type column in test disagreements is the current candidate prediction, not a reference answer.
